asks.ask: When a push of the run's branch or of `logs` is rejected because the remote moved, fetch, rebase the run's own commits onto the new tip, and push again (a few tries).
Only if the rebase conflicts does the run fail, and then the record names the conflicting files.
The run that dispatches the next agent does so only after its own pushes have landed.

One result: the log lands on top of the moved logs branch.
One result: no next agent when a push did not land.
